name: style
description: A house writing voice for every Vyre-owned session (ADR 0037): a system-prompt block, on by default, banning em dashes, throat-clearing, sycophancy and other AI writing tells; a person's own free-text addition on top; the banned-pattern list as data for a surface's own lint.

settings.label: House writing style
settings.help: Bans em dashes, throat-clearing, sycophancy and other AI writing tells in every session. Off leaves the model's own default voice.

settings.label: Your own writing rules
settings.help: Free text, added after the house rules, up to 500 characters. For example: "never use the word delve" or "sign off notes with my initials".

tips.text: Turn off the house writing style for one project in Settings > Style, or with `settings.set` on `style.enabled`.
